text: Rudolfo Anaya's Bless Me, Ultima was removed in 1999 from the Laton, Calif. Unified School District because it contains violence and profanity that might harm students. In 2001 former Quincy High School teacher Bob Hiss and parent Tim West challenged the book; Hiss objected to its language and anti-Catholic tone. The school district's book review hearing panel, with 14 members, voted unanimously to keep it on the reading list. In November 2008 Newman-Crows Landing Unified School District Superintendent Rick Fauss removed the book from district high school classes after one parent objected to it as "anti-Catholic." On February 2, 2009, the school board voted 4-1 to uphold the removal from classrooms; the book remains in the school library.
